symptom: The ref coverage trace (TestCatalog_RefCoverageOfProject) found reads of another document with no refs edge: 65 on FactoryManagement, 42 on EVORA - ICX. show references / impact missed the reader, five FactoryManagement entities in use read as unreferenced, and an incremental build did not rebuild a flow naming an enumeration value when the value was added.
cause: The member-refs walk matched an entity name only in mappings, so an entity named as a result variable type, a created list, an entity-type Java/JavaScript argument, a snippet parameter or an association step's destination made no edge; a value missing from an existing enumeration made none either. The same walk read annotation captions, text translations and AllowedModuleRoles as if they could be references.
insight: Classify every uncovered read by the BSON key that holds the string (bson dump + a key-path search) before adding edges: 12 of the 65 were not uses at all (annotation prose, static text, a module role named like an entity), and an edge for those would make show references wrong. The walk needs the owner AND parent $Type, since DataTypes$ObjectType.Entity is a use under ResultHandling but already a typed parameter/return edge elsewhere. A microflow call's result has no stored type (ResultVariableName only), so a fixture probe needs an import/Java call. A path probe that ends in /Attr is already covered by the attribute edge; only a path ending on the entity reproduces. dependents() is not transitive through calls, so each probe must name the domain model through one construct only.
